note: Curated list — not a live feed. Verify every url and phone before shipping; they change. Display strings are English (app audience = US patients).

organizations.name: Dollar For
organizations.whatItDoes: Helps you apply for hospital charity care. Nonprofit hospitals are required to offer financial assistance, and Dollar For handles the paperwork for you.
organizations.whoQualifies: Anyone with a bill from a nonprofit hospital. Based on income and family size.

organizations.name: NeedyMeds
organizations.whatItDoes: Free directory of prescription savings programs, patient assistance programs, and low-cost clinics. Free drug discount card.
organizations.whoQualifies: Anyone. No income or insurance requirement for the discount card.

organizations.name: 211 (United Way)
organizations.whatItDoes: Free, confidential helpline that connects you to local health, food, housing, and financial-assistance resources.

organizations.name: HRSA health center helpline
organizations.whatItDoes: Federal helpline to locate a nearby community health center and confirm services.
organizations.whoQualifies: Anyone looking for low-cost primary care.

organizations.name: Free and charitable clinics (NAFC)
organizations.whatItDoes: Directory of volunteer-run free and charitable clinics and pharmacies, often at no cost for the uninsured.
organizations.whoQualifies: Usually uninsured or underinsured, income-based. Varies by clinic.

organizations.name: Medicaid and CHIP
organizations.whatItDoes: Free or very low-cost government health coverage for people with low income. CHIP covers children.
organizations.whoQualifies: Income-based. Limits vary by state; some states have not expanded Medicaid.

organizations.name: ACA Marketplace (HealthCare.gov)
organizations.whatItDoes: Health insurance with income-based subsidies. Some plans have low or zero monthly premiums.
organizations.whoQualifies: Most people without job or government coverage. Subsidies are income-based.

organizations.name: GoodRx
organizations.whatItDoes: Compares prescription prices and gives discount coupons at pharmacies nationwide.
organizations.whoQualifies: Anyone. Works in place of insurance.

organizations.name: TotalAssist (PAN + Patient Advocate Foundation)
organizations.whatItDoes: Copay and out-of-pocket grants plus free case management for around 150 serious and chronic conditions.
organizations.whoQualifies: Usually need insurance and a specific qualifying diagnosis. Rarely covers full cost for the uninsured.

organizations.name: HealthWell Foundation
organizations.whatItDoes: Grants for copays, premiums, deductibles, and travel for underinsured patients with specific diseases.
organizations.whoQualifies: Must have insurance and a covered diagnosis. Income up to about 500% of the federal poverty level.

organizations.name: Undue Medical Debt
organizations.whatItDoes: Buys and forgives medical debt. You cannot apply — recipients are notified once their debt is cleared.
